name: 91803 · Alhambra, CA
findings: ZIP 91803 (Alhambra) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91803 (Alhambra) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91803 (Alhambra) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
